title: Entity measurement display
responsibility: Formats one unit’s recorded size and declared performance measurements without combining profiles.

inputs.name: entityMeasure.unit
inputs.description: The unit supplies source measurements, the ID used to filter measurements, owned symbols used to filter callable-specific measurements, and performance budgets used to create rows. Its runtime targets determine which emitted process or Wasm size rows appear.

examples.title: Entity measurement display
examples.responsibility: Formats one unit’s recorded size and declared performance measurements without combining profiles.

inputs.name: entityMeasure.record
inputs.description: The selected record contributes measurements and emitted-size or budget-judgment data; null leaves record-backed measurements unavailable while unit source measurements and explicit observations can still appear. Record status and validity are not checked before its measurements are used.

inputs.name: entityMeasure.observations
inputs.description: Additional measurements appended after unit source measurements and record measurements, then filtered to this unit and its owned callables. Defaults to [].

inputs.name: byteSize.count
inputs.description: A byte count to format; absolute magnitude selects B, KB, or MB while the original sign is preserved. The scale thresholds are 1,000 and 1,000,000 bytes, and non-integer scaled values are rounded to one decimal place.

outputs.name: notMeasured
outputs.description: The Not measured placeholder used for absent or unavailable measurements, so missing data is not displayed as zero.

outputs.name: tolerancePolicy
outputs.description: The fixed tolerance threshold used by PerformanceRow.over. A row is marked over only when its budget tolerance is defined and greater than 0.05.

outputs.name: byteSize
outputs.description: Formats a byte count with decimal B, KB, or MB units, using 1,000 bytes per KB and 1,000,000 bytes per MB. Non-integer scaled values are rounded to one decimal place and the input sign is retained.

outputs.name: entityMeasure
outputs.description: Returns size and performance arrays: size includes source-byte and complexity rows plus emitted-size rows for process/Wasm targets (or one none row), with missing measurements shown as Not measured. Unit source measurements, record measurements, and explicit observations are combined in that order and filtered to this unit and its owned callables; each performance budget yields its matching observations separately or a placeholder, while unbudgeted rows require both workload and profile.
